summary.text: Mike Netter is the Republican candidate for California State Senate District 22 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Susan Rubio.
A business owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he wants to create safer neighborhoods and lower costs.

paragraphs.text: Mike Netter earned a bachelor's degree from San Diego State University in 1979, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business owner.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary in second place behind Rubio.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he wants to create safer neighborhoods, improve daily quality of life and lower the cost of living.
